attempted: Searched for WorkstreamBench and the renamed MBABench public release.
Verified the arXiv record now points to MBABench v4.
Verified the public MBABench GitHub repository, scorer entrypoint, rubric JSON, and no-provider --nocall smoke path.
Verified the public Hugging Face ModelOff task dataset revision and metadata count.
Checked out the pinned MBABench repository commit c56319bea67fa5bfea8ed8010e93a88e1b8877e5 under .tmp/mbabench-official for local command-surface inspection.
Ran the pinned judge CLI help with PYTHONPATH pointed at judge/ to avoid the local utils-module collision.
Ran the pinned no-provider judge smoke on judge/scratch/test_cases/Bread_And_Butter with --nocall; it completed file preparation and prompt generation without provider calls.
Confirmed --nocall produced judge_results/fileprompt.txt but did not produce judge_results/scores.json or judge_results/ai_judgement.json, so it is not an accepted official score receipt.
Generated WorkstreamBench official-format MBABench output manifest with 38 expected tasks, 38 case folders, 38 ai_attempt.xlsx files, and 38 solution workbooks.

Ran the pinned judge without --nocall for one exported case (task_0) using the zero-cost OpenRouter route nvidia/nemotron-3-super-120b-a12b:free; the run completed and produced scores.json, ai_judgement.json, _metadata.json, and token_tracking.json.

The task_0 shadow run used a model override instead of the configured google/gemini-3-flash-preview route and covered only 1/38 cases; it is therefore not an accepted official scorer receipt. Its token_tracking.json reports 577405 tokens and an internal fallback cost estimate of 6.00487 USD; the selected :free route was used to avoid paid provider spend.
Did not run the official MBABench scoring path because provider credentials/spend and an accepted upstream judge receipt are not available for this no-spend pass.
